title: flow-tester require-output
description: Expected output flowfiles for a flow-tester run (--require-output), keyed by output label: a relationship's <processor-name>-<relationship-name>, or an output port's name.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor validation/autocomplete. Ignored by flow-tester itself.

outputs.description: Map of output label to the list of flowfiles expected there. A label flow-tester doesn't actually produce fails verification; a label not mentioned here is never checked.

additionalProperties.description: The exact flowfiles expected at this output, in order. The count must match exactly.

content.description: Exact expected content, as a UTF-8 string. Mutually exclusive with contentFile. Omit to not check content at all.

contentFile.description: Path (relative to this require-output file) to a file whose exact bytes are the expected content. Mutually exclusive with content.

attributes.description: Attributes that must match exactly. Attributes not listed here are never checked -- leave out anything dynamic (uuid, path, timestamps, ...).
